description_zh: 调用CreateCacheAnalysisJob接口，创建缓存分析任务
kebab_example: aliyun das create-cache-analysis-job --instance-id r-bp18ff4a195d0000 --node-id r-x0000-db-0 --backup-set-id 12345 --separators example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCacheAnalysisJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data node on the instance. You can specify this parameter to query the monitoring information about the specified node.

If you specify the BackupSetId parameter, the system ignores the NodeId parameter. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例的数据节点ID，传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。
当您传入BackupSetId参数，系统会忽略此参数，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query the ID.

If you need to specify multiple backup file IDs, separate them with commas (,). For example, you can set this parameter to `12345,67890`.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically backs up the task and performs cache analysis on the backup file
parameters.help_zh:
备份文件ID，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html接口获取。

如需传入多个备份文件ID，请使用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如`12345,67890`。
如果不传入本参数，系统会自动执行备份并对该备份文件执行缓存分析
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The delimiters used to identify the prefixes of keys. You do not need to specify this parameter if one or more of the following default delimiters are used: `: ; , _ - + @ = | #`
parameters.help_zh: 用于识别Key前缀的分隔符。当分隔符为默认的`:;,_-+@=|#`时，不需要输入
parameters.name: separators

KeyInfo.description_en: The number of elements in the key
KeyInfo.description_zh: 大Key详细信息，根据Key占用字节数降序排列

Bytes.description_en: The number of bytes that are occupied by the key

Count.description_en: The number of elements in the key

Encoding.description_en: The data type of the key

ExpirationTimeMillis.description_en: The expiration period of the key. Unit: milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the key does not expire
ExpirationTimeMillis.description_zh: Key过期时间，单位：毫秒（ms），0表示不过期

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the data node on the instance

Type.description_en: The data type of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance

JobId.description_en:
The ID of the cache analysis task.

This parameter can be used to query a specific cache analysis task. When you call the CreateCacheAnalysisJob operation, it takes some time to create a cache analysis task. As a result, the analysis results cannot be immediately returned. You can call the [DescribeCacheAnalysisJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180983.html） operation to query the analysis results of the specified cache analysis task
JobId.description_zh:
缓存分析任务ID。
此参数可用于查询缓存分析任务使用，当您调用该API时，由于创建缓存分析任务需要一定的时间，不会立即返回分析结果，您需要通过此参数，结合[DescribeCacheAnalysisJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180983.html）接口，查询具体的分析结果

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the data node on the instance

TaskState.description_en:
The state of the cache analysis task. Valid values:

BACKUP: The data is being backed up.

ANALYZING: The data is being analyzed.

FINISHED: The data is analyzed.

FAILED: An error occurred
TaskState.description_zh:
缓存分析任务的状态：

BACKUP：备份中。
ANALYZING：分析中。
FINISHED：分析完成。
FAILED：出现错误

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
